checks.name: SINGLE|ACP pins its own output j
checks.detail: one-sat change to output j flips the digest

checks.name: SINGLE|ACP ignores another party's output (k>j)
checks.detail: changing output 2 leaves signer 1's digest fixed

checks.name: SINGLE|ACP ignores other inputs
checks.detail: changing input 0's prevout leaves signer 1's digest fixed

checks.name: SINGLE|ACP does NOT fence appended outputs (the leak)
checks.detail: 4 extra outputs appended, signer 1's digest unchanged -> pool not fenced

checks.name: legacy sighash does not commit the input amount
checks.detail: no value in the serialized input -> conservation needs BIP143 or inspection

checks.name: ALL|ACP fences every output
checks.detail: changing ANY output flips the digest

checks.name: ALL|ACP fences appended outputs too
checks.detail: appending outputs flips the digest (unlike SINGLE)

checks.name: ALL|ACP still ignores appended inputs
checks.detail: changing a non-signing input's prevout leaves the digest fixed

checks.name: whole-tx core changes with the spending input's prevout
checks.detail: a Binohash core over the tx depends on the spent input's txid:vout

checks.name: baked-constant-equals-own-core is a fixed point (structural)
checks.detail: K -> redeem -> scriptPubKey -> funding txid -> prevout -> core must equal K

checks.name: constant-one is identical across unrelated txs (reusable authority)
checks.detail: a signature over 0^63||1 is not bound to any particular transaction

checks.name: a decoy output at index i evades the collapse (break)
checks.detail: custodian keeps a dust decoy at index i -> ordinary digest -> no tripwire

checks.name: tamper breaks the victim party's own row-pin
tamper simultaneously breaks the closer's freeze
an untouched party's row-pin still verifies after the tamper
checks.detail: party 0 is unaffected -- rows are independent

checks.name: appending an uncommitted output breaks the closer's freeze
checks.detail: no output can join the table after the ALL|ACP freeze
